source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

stages.goal: Finish all five story chapters and the character strands as they open up.
stages.name: Play the story
steps: Play through the story with Jason and Lucia — no gold medals are needed in story missions.

Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth: find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning. When she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept. Do this before leaving Chapter 1 — it is the one possibly missable trophy (Positive Mental Attitude).
Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter. There is no mission replay, so separate saves are your only backup.
Scan new vehicles and landmarks with the WAiNK app and study new animals with binoculars as you meet them — 100% completion later wants 200 base-model vehicles and 100 animal species.
Leave cheats off: using them disables trophies and saving while active.

stages.goal: Work the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) after the story.
stages.name: Reach 100% completion
steps: Robberies first: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 34 of 35 smash 'n' grabs, 50 of 91 stick ups, all 8 bank vaults — the vaults unlock with the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' in Chapter 4.
Fence $100,000 of narcotics, $100,000 of jewelry, $250,000 of marked bills and $200,000 of vehicles.

Collectibles: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 30 of 34 magazines/books/comics, 15 of 18 meditations (all 18 for the trophy), 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 2 playlists, 70 of 79 styles.

Activities: 30 of 40 races won, 10 of 13 race golds, all 42 shooting range golds, all 4 video games, 5 of 7 pool opponents, mini-golf at 2 of 3 spots, 90 of 100 basketball hoops, all 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, all 15 of Bret's Target Decks.
Stop each activity once its checklist number is met — you do not need to collect literally everything.

stages.goal: Close out the stranger strands and whatever trophies are left, then the platinum pops.
stages.name: Finish the strands and clean up
steps: Finish the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone if you have not already.
Complete eight full Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida.
Finish the remaining meditation spots for Positive Mental Attitude.
Sweep up the combat, driving, robbery and miscellaneous trophies (Gunslinger, Catch Me If You Can, the shop robberies with your partner).
Check the list: once all 54 others are ticked, Vice Got a Price! unlocks.

summary: Three stages, about 200 hours, one playthrough. Every trophy is offline single-player, and you can keep exploring Leonida freely after the story ends — so the only thing you can truly miss is one meditation in Chapter 1.
title: Roadmap to the platinum
